notes:
Orrery 0.17.0

Cards
- Silent, Byte, Creative Canvas, Fog and Mist, and World's End were rebuilt: new text, new cards, and fixes to cards that could lock a duel. The old versions stay in the Database as Pre-Errata cards.
- New Byte cards, including Hilobyte Supreme Heroine, Dracabyte Savage Guardian, Dracabyte Volcantyranno and Dracabyte Unrivaled Ruler Gluttony Nebiros.
- New card art, popups and card sounds. Open Settings and pick Download / Update Art and Download / Update Audio to get them.
- A few cards show an amber eye: their balance is being watched and they may change in a later update. Search "watched" to see them all.

Dueling
- Effects now prompt when a card goes from the GY back to the Deck, or when a Spell or Trap is negated.
- "Sent to the GY by a card effect" and "except its own" triggers can tell battle, effects and costs apart.
- Excavating from the top or bottom of the Deck, putting cards back in the order you pick, and Fusion Summons that use monsters from the GY.
- "The first time it would be destroyed each turn, it is not" now saves the card for you.
- More ATK changes are worked out for you (counters, Attributes in the GY), cards that give an extra Normal Summon count it, and monsters that can attack more than once get the right number of attacks.
- Warnings when a card can't be targeted, when a card stops you Tributing, and for "You can only control 1" cards.
- React: send your opponent a reaction from the Tools box. Ping: right-click any card, yours or theirs, to point it out. Both work on either turn.
